title: The Elusive Samurai Anime's 2nd Season Casts Niina Hanamiya
content:
The staff for the second television anime season based on Yūsei Matsui 's The Elusive Samurai ( Nigejōzu no Wakagimi ) manga revealed on Friday that Niina Hanamiya is joining the cast as Mima.

The new season began airing on July 17 at 11:30 p.m. on the Fuji TV network in the Noitamina programming block, and it also runs on AT-X . Amazon Prime Video and other services are streaming the series in Japan.

Crunchyroll is streaming the series as it airs.

Yuta Yamazaki (assistant director for Wonder Egg Priority , series director for both Love Rice series) returns to direct for season 2 at CloverWorks , and Yasushi Nishiya also returns (chief animation director for Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us , Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You! ) to design the characters and assume the new role of chief animation director. Shinnosuke Ōta serves as animation director, while GEMBI and Akiyuki Tateyama compose the music.

Kento Nakajima performs the opening theme song "Onigoto" and Bocchiboromaru performs the ending theme song "Romantic ga Hoshii nara" (If You Wish for Romance) with three guest vocalists from idol group Hinatazaka46.

The anime's first season debuted in July 2024. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired, and is also streaming an English dub.

Viz Media is releasing the manga in print, and the company describes the first volume:

After the massacre of his family by the traitor Ashikaga Takauji, Tokiyuki flees with the help of a handful of loyal retainers who have also survived the purge. One of them is Suwa Yorishige, an ally of the Hojo clan and lord of Suwa Province. The slightly odd Yorishige also claims to be clairvoyant and foretells that Tokiyuki will one day become the ruler of Japan. But for the moment, escaping from enemy territory is the priority!

Matsui ( Majin Tantei Nōgami Neuro , Assassination Classroom ) launched the manga in Weekly Shonen Jump in January 2021, and ended it on February 16. The manga won at the 69th Shogakukan Manga Awards in 2024.

Viz Media and MANGA Plus both simultaneously released new chapters of the manga in English digitally as they debuted in Japan.
author: ANN

title: My Girlfriend's Friend TV Anime Reveals More Cast, October 4 Debut in Video
content:
The official website for the television anime of Jura 's My Girlfriend's Friend ( Kanojo no Tomodachi ) manga revealed more cast, the main promotional video, and the October 4 debut for the series on Friday.

Note: The below video is not safe for work.

The new cast members include Riho Sugiyama as Miyuki and Ryōka Yuzuki as Kaori's mother.

Additionally, the webstie revealed the opening and ending theme songs. Airots performs the opening theme song "Gingira" and Ceui performs the ending theme song "False Love." The above video previews the opening theme.

The website also revealed a new visual that is not safe for work.

The anime will debut on Tokyo MX on October 4 at 25:05 (effectively October 5 at 1:05 a.m.), and will air on BS11 on October 7. The "Complete Deregula " version of the show will stream on AnimeFesta starting on October 5 at 1:05 a.m., and AnimeFesta and other services will also stream the on-air version of the show.

The anime will star:

• Ryūga Nagaike as Takeru

• Sayahana Hanemurasaki as Kaori

• Miki Hase as Tomoko

Takashi Andō is directing the anime at Quad . WWWave Corporation is credited as producer. Deregula is credited for production. Gokō Shiraki ( Hands off: Sawaranaide Kotesashi-kun ) is writing and supervising the series' scripts. Ryūji Iwata is designing the characters, and is also credited as chief animation director alongside Akira Koshiishi and Konatsu Kumagai . Hiroki Nishiyama is the sound director. Makoto Tōgō is the director of photography. Jun'ichi Masunaga is the editor. Naoto Awano is the animation producer. Naoki Onimaru is credited for setting production. Takafumi Suzuki is the producer, and Kazuki Yanase is the publicity producer.

Kazuma Akagi ( 9-nine- Ruler's Crown ) is the prop designer, Do Kim Hoan Tran ( Marika's Love Meter Malfunction ) is the art director, and Momoka Saeki is in charge of color design.

Jura debuted the manga in Kodansha 's YanMaga Web in May 2021. Kodansha published the manga's seventh compiled book volume on July 16.

The story follows high school boy Takeru, who has a girlfriend named Kaori. Kaori confessed her feelings to him and became his first-ever girlfriend. However, Kaori's friend Tomoko begins to seduce him and tempt him with her voluptuous figure.

WWWave Corporation 's Deregula anime label is producing the anime.
author: ANN

title: 'Shinja Zero no Megami-sama to Hajimeru Isekai Kouryaku' Reveals Additional Cast, Theme Songs
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Isle Oosaki 's Shinja Zero no Megami-sama to Hajimeru Isekai Kouryaku ( Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers ) light novel revealed additional cast, a key visual (pictured), and the theme songs on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 11 at 11.30 p.m. on BS Asahi, followed by Tokyo MX and AT-X.

Cast Lucy J. Walker: Yukina Shutou ( Uma Musume: Pretty Derby ) Aya Sasaki: Hitomi Sekine ( The iDOLM@STER Shiny Colors ) Michio Fujiwara: Masaaki Mizunaka ( Isekai Maou to Shoukan Shoujo no Dorei Majutsu Ω ) Nina: Lynn ( Bokutachi wa Benkyou ga Dekinai ) Ryousuke Sakurai: Kensho Ono ( Kuroko no Basket ) Sofia Eir Roses: Sayumi Suzushiro ( Seihantai na Kimi to Boku ) Mary: Rumi Ookubo ( Mayonaka Heart Tune )

Singer 310 ( Guild no Uketsukejou desu ga, Zangyou wa Iya nanode Boss wo Solo Toubatsu Shiyou to Omoimasu ) is performing the opening theme "Mirai no Ashiato." Musical group Suupeas is performing the ending theme "Fall in Dream."

Toshinori Fukushima ( Chichi wa Eiyuu, Haha wa Seirei, Musume no Watashi wa Tenseisha. ) is directing the anime at HORNETS , with Touko Machida ( Maougun Saikyou no Majutsushi wa Ningen datta ) handling the series composition and script. Noriko Itou ( Undead Girl Murder Farce ) is designing the characters. AstroNoteS ( Majo no Tabitabi ) is composing the music.

Oosaki began penning the fantasy romance novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in May 2018. Overlap later acquired the series and began publishing the light novel in print under its Overlap Bunko imprint in March 2019, featuring illustrations by Tam-U . Overlap published the 13th volume on April 20, with the 14th and final volume scheduled for a September 20 release.

Comic Gardo began serializing a manga adaptation by Hakuto Shiroi in April 2020. Overlap published the tenth volume on January 25.

J-Novel Club licensed both the light novel and manga adaptation in English. The 12th light novel volume was released in October 2024, and the tenth manga volume went on sale on July 29.

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Releases Creditless Second Anime Ending Featuring "ONE NIGHT STAR" by The ARROWS
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its second ending, featuring the song “ONE NIGHT STAR” by The ARROWS. The song was used in Episodes 13-29, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.

The release follows yesterday’s release of the first ending song featuring “Michishirube” by Keita Tachibana . The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.

These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the third entry below.

The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!

title: 'Soukou Kihei Votoms: Haiiro no Hexe' Announces Supporting Cast, Additional Staff
content:
The official website of the Soukou Kihei Votomos: Haiiro no Hexe ( Armored Trooper Votoms: Die Graue Hexe ) anime announced supporting cast and additional staff members on Friday. The anime will premiere as two movies, with the first one scheduled to open in theaters on November 20.

Cast Alix Ballack: Shinichiro Miki ( Bleach ) Ignis Schweinsteiger: Yuuki Kaji ( Shingeki no Kyojin ) Fritz Gersdorf: Yuuichi Nakamura ( Jujutsu Kaisen ) Brunhard Müller: Satoshi Tsuruoka ( Fate/Zero ) Adrian Deisler: Tomokazu Sugita ( Gintama ) Matt Hummels: Kenta Miyake ( Boku no Hero Academia ) Soltig van Gunnar: Chafuurin ( Higurashi no Naku Koro ni ) Wid Hildebrandt: Houchuu Ootsuka ( Naruto ) Meteusz Julian Podolski: Daisuke Ono ( Kuroshitsuji ) Weissweiler: Takayuki Sugou ( Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagann ) Oliver: Takahiro Sakurai ( Mob Psycho 100 ) Mechanic girl: Sumire Uesaka ( Ijiranaide, Nagatoro-san )

Staff Original Mechanical Design: Kunio Okawara ( Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Freedom ) Mechanical Design: Shinobu Tsuneki ( Kaijuu 8-gou ), Yoshihiro Sono ( Urusei Yatsura (2022) ), Juu Ishiguchi ( Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online ), Wataru Inata ( Reincarnation no Kaben ) Costume Design: Katsuya Terada ( Fate/Grand Order: Zettai Majuu Sensen Babylonia original character design) Art Design: Satoshi Takabatake ( Hello World ). Yasumitsu Suetake ( Guilty Crown ), Kazushige Kanehira ( Steins;Gate ) Art Director: Yuuji Honjou ( Virgin Punk: Clockwork Girl ) Color Design: Nagisa Abe ( 86 ) Director of Photography: Yuuki Kawashita ( Vinland Saga ) CG Director: Yohta Tasaki, Toshihisa Yokoshima ( Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru storyboard), Takeshi Nakajima Editing: Aya Hida ( Fruits Basket )

Mamoru Oshii is directing the anime at Sunrise , with Production I.G credited for production cooperation. Mamoru Oshii ( Ghost in the Shell , Kidou Keisatsu Patlabor ), and Kei Yamamura ( Vlad Love ) are penning the script. Tetsuya Nishio ( Kaijuu 8-gou ), Takashi Kojima ( Kimi to, Nami ni Noretara ), and Shingo Ogiso ( Arslan Senki (TV) ) are designing the characters. Kenji Kawai ( Koukaku Kidoutai ) is composing the music. Kazuhiro Wakabayashi ( Sen to Chihiro no Kamikakushi ) is serving as the sound director.

The original sci-fi drama television anime aired in 52 episodes from Spring 1983 to Winter 1984. The Red Shoulder Document - Yabou no Roots ( Roots of Treachery ) prequel OVA debuted in March 1988, followed by the 12-episode Pailsen Files OVA from October 2007 to August 2008. A Pailsen Files movie adaptation premiered in Japan in January 2009, featuring a new story.

The five-episode Kakuyaku taru Itan ( Brilliantly Shining Heresy ) sequel OVA was released from March to November in 1994, followed by the six-episode Genei-hen ( Phantom Arc ) OVA from March to October in 2010 and Koei Futatabi ( Alone Again ) OVA in 2011.

The latest spin-off installments in the franchise, Case;Irvine and Votoms Finder ( Votoms Finder Armored Trooperoid ), were released in November and December in 2010.

title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 47 Preview Images and Synopsis Revealed
content:
BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 has revealed the preview for Episode 7 (Episode 47 overall). The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25. It is set to run for 10 episodes.

The fifth episode is titled “THE END 2,” and it will premiere on Saturday, September 5. You can see the synopsis and preview images below.

Even Ichigo’s Bankai cannot reach Yhwach. For the first time, despair clouds the eyes of the man who never gave up, no matter how powerful the enemy. But his comrades have not yet abandoned hope. Kyoraku rises after awakening from a brief slumber, while Uryu, having defeated Haschwalth, moves to eliminate the massive “distortion” that has appeared beneath Wahrwelt. To stop the end from coming, and prevent the destruction of the Three Worlds.

ALSO READ: Interview: Ichigo Voice Actors Masakazu Morita and Johnny Yong Bosch Talk BLEACH BLEACH JET Artbook and Ryogo Narita’s School Life Novel Return, Fan Vote and 2027 Exhibition Announced

BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 47 Staff:

• Script: Tomohisa Taguchi

• Storyboard: 四条京介

• Episode Director: Shintaro Matsui

• Chief Animation Director: Kumiko Takayanagi

• Animation Directors: Minami Shiba, Kumiko Horikoshi

Created by Tite Kubo, BLEACH was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump from 2001 to 2016 and concluded with 74 volumes. The manga has exceeded 130 million copies in circulation worldwide, making it one of the best-selling manga series of all time.

The original anime adaptation aired from 2004 to 2012 and received four theatrical films. The franchise returned in 2022 with BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War , adapting the manga’s final arc. Its final part (Part 4) is set to release in July. Tite Kubo has confirmed it will include even more original material than the previous parts , expanding the manga’s final battles.

On a related note, BLEACH: Mirrors High revealed its protagonists in a new trailer, with the game featuring original character designs by Tite Kubo.

title: Adventure Time Revival Confirms Season 2 Hulu Release Date With New Look
content:
Adventure Time premiered on Cartoon Network in April 2010 and ran for ten seasons before concluding in September 2018, growing into one of the most acclaimed animated series ever on the strength of the offbeat brotherly bond between Finn the Human (voiced by Jeremy Shada) and his shape-shifting adoptive dog, Jake (voiced by John DiMaggio). Creator Pendleton Ward’s Land of Ooo continued well past that finale, expanding through comics, video games, and a series of follow-up shows that kept the cast in front of audiences for years afterward, with the franchise now being a recurring fixture for multiple generations. Adventure Time: Side Quests , a companion series that returns to Finn and Jake’s earliest years together , is the newest of those follow-ups, and its next batch of episodes just landed a release date.

Hulu revealed the Season 2 premiere date for Adventure Time: Side Quests alongside brand-new key art, confirming that all 20 episodes will drop as a single batch on October 2nd. The artwork shows Finn (voiced by Sasha Knight) and Jake (voiced by DiMaggio) soaring above the kingdom as treasure and medieval weapons spill out of Finn’s backpack. The turnaround puts barely three months between seasons, and Season 2 matches the size of Season 1, bringing the series’ total episode count to 40 since Side Quests premiered on June 29th .

What Adventure Time: Side Quests Is About?

Set earlier in the Land of Ooo’s timeline than the original series, Side Quests follows a younger Finn and Jake through standalone, self-contained scrapes rather than the long-form arcs that later seasons of the franchise have leaned on . The structure mirrors the loose rhythm of Adventure Time ’s earliest seasons, prioritizing quick comedic detours over the show’s ongoing mythology. After working in the original series, showrunner Nate Cash developed Side Quests for Cartoon Network Studios as a lighter companion piece that can be enjoyed by newcomers and veterans alike, and so far the series has been a delightful return to Ooo. In addition to the leading stars, Season 2’s voice cast also brings back Tom Kenny as Ice King, Hynden Walch as Princess Bubblegum, Olivia Olson as Marceline, and Niki Yang as BMO, ensuring the most important characters of the original run are still represented in the revival.

Side Quests is only the most recent addition to a franchise that has steadily multiplied since 2018. HBO Max released Adventure Time: Distant Lands between June 2020 and September 2021, four hourlong specials that followed BMO, Marceline, Princess Bubblegum, Peppermint Butler, and a reunited Finn and Jake through standalone stories set after the series finale. Warner Bros. Discovery has since greenlit Adventure Time: Heyo BMO for Cartoon Network and Adventure Time: Bubblegum and Marceline for HBO Max , while Side Quests lives on Disney+ and Hulu. Finally, Adventure Time: Fionna and Cake offers a different version of the Ooo universe. Developed by Adam Muto for Max, the series follows gender-bent counterparts of Finn and Jake named Fionna Campbell and Cake the Cat, characters first introduced in a 2011 episode as fan fiction written by Simon Petrikov, the human form of the Ice King.

Adventure Time: Side Quests Season 2 premieres on Disney+ and Hulu on October 2nd.

title: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 Anime Reveals 3rd Promo Video, More Cast
content:
The staff for the second television anime season based on Nigojū and Umibōzu 's The Detective Is Already Dead ( Tantei wa Mō, Shindeiru. ) light novel series revealed the anime's third promotional video, more cast members, and October 7 debut on Friday.

New cast members include Akari Komiyama as Mia Whitlock and Nobuhiko Okamoto as Scarlet, both introduced in the above video.

The anime will debut on October 7 at 10:30 p.m. on Tokyo MX , but will stream first starting at 10:00 p.m. on d Anime Store . The anime will also air on AT-X and BS NTV , and will also stream on other services.

The returning cast includes:

• Arata Nagai as Kimihiko Kimizuka

• Saki Miyashita as Siesta

• Ayana Taketatsu as Nagisa Natsunagi

• Kanon Takao as Yui Saikawa

• Saho Shirasu as Charlotte Arisaka Anderson

• Mai Fuchigami as Fūbi Kase

• Yumiri Hanamori as Hell

• Maria Naganawa as Alicia

• Yoshitsugu Matsuoka as Kōmori

• Saki Miyashita as Noches

Manabu Kurihara returns to direct the second season at ENGI . Deko Akao is again in charge of series scripts, and Yōsuke Itō is again designing the characters.

40mP is composing the anime's music, along with composing, arranging, and writing the lyrics for the theme songs. Kōme performs the opening "Kono Shinzō ni Hanabata wo" (A Bouquet for This Heart), and Kagura Nana returns to perform the ending "Hakuchumu" (Daydreams).

The anime's second season was first announced in July 2022.

The anime's first season premiered with a one-hour special in July 2021 and aired for 12 episodes. Funimation began streaming the anime in July 2021, and also streamed an English dub. Funimation describes the story:

The series follows Kimizuka Kimihiko, a young man who is always getting into trouble, as he finds himself the assistant of Siesta, a globe-trotting detective, and the two of them solve a series of mysteries. But after years of adventuring and saving lives, Siesta mysteriously dies, though her legacy will shape the lives of Kimihiko and others as they move forward.

Nigojū published the first volume in the light novel series with illustrations by Umibōzu in November 2019 under Kadokawa 's MF Bunko J imprint. The novel won the 15th MF Bunko J newcomer award in 2019. Kadokawa published the 13th volume in July 2025. Yen Press is publishing the original novels in English.

Hoko Hinachi and Minori Chigusa launched a new spinoff novel titled Charlotte wa Tada, Jiken o Tokitai. Tantei wa Mō, Shindeiru. Code:RED in May 2024. Nigojū is credited for the original work and as a supervisor for the novel.

Mugiko launched the manga adaptation of the novels in Kadokawa 's Monthly Comic Alive magazine in May 2020, and ended it in October 2023. Kadokawa published the manga's sixth and final compiled book volume in October 2023.

title: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 Reveals Third Trailer and New Cast, October 7 Premiere
content:
The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 revealed its third main trailer, along with new voice cast members and October 7, 2026 premiere date. Nobuhiko Okamoto joins the cast as Scarlet, one of the Tuners and a character identified as the “Vampire.” Akari Komiyama will voice Mia Whitlock, another member of the Tuners who holds the role of “Priestess.”

The opening theme, “Kono Shinzou ni Hanataba wo” (A Bouquet for This Heart), is written, composed, and arranged by 40mP and performed by Kokorone. The ending theme, “Hakuchumu” (Daydream), is also written, composed, and arranged by 40mP, with vocals by Kagura Nana. Both are featured in the new trailer.

The first season of the anime ended on September 19, 2021, after a total of 12 episodes. Manabu Kurihara directed it at studio ENGI. The main cast consists of:

• Saki Miyashita as Siesta

• Ayana Taketatsu as Nagisa Natsunagi

• Arata Nagai as Kimihiko Kimizuka

• Kanon Tako as Yui Saikawa

A key visual for the second season was previously revealed.

The Detective is Already Dead is a Japanese light novel series written by Nigozyu and illustrated by Umibozu. Media Factory started publishing the series in November 2019. The series also has 2 manga adaptation: one by Mugiko (2020-2023) and one by Poni (2021-2022).

Yen Press licensed The Detective is Already Dead light novel series in English. Crunchyroll streams the anime, describing the story: After thwarting a hijacking with beautiful, silver-haired detective Siesta, Kimihiko leads a life of globe-trotting and crime-solving—until Siesta dies. A year later, a new case will open old wounds as it threads murder, conspiracy, and his dead partner!

It was previously confirmed that The Detective Is Already Dead light novel Volume 14 will be released in Japan on October 23, with its cover illustration revealed.

title: Hakuhodo Teases New Project in Videos
content:
Entertainment company Hakuhodo DY Music & Pictures teased in two videos on Friday that it will announce a new project on September 10 at 7:00 p.m. JST. The company also teased the project with the phrase "That man will return."

Hakuhodo DY Music & Pictures also revealed several social media accounts for the project that feature the username "OverOrder." The work's copyright notation is "©AY/ETOOP."

Hakuhodo DY Music & Pictures (previously Showgate ) is involved in production for animation, films, games, events, and music.
